verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an approvals area, transaction update and reconciliation, and receipt linking. None of it documents a per-expense audit trail recording edits, approvals, or policy checks, or audit-grade retention. These are adjacent features, not the audit-trail capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
